integrity: The proof is analytic. Exact algebraic identities are replayed by a bundled standard-library checker; finite computation is not used as a substitute for the convergence proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the positive 2+2 pair-symmetric projective ray, not arbitrary boundary messages or full Gibbs uniqueness.
The zero-temperature model is globally non-unique at q=d+1; this result identifies one stable channel and does not classify the unstable/non-unique channels.
A relevant 1983 Bethe-lattice article was compared from bibliographic and abstract material rather than full text.
title: Critical pair-symmetric relaxation for proper four-colourings of the 4-regular tree
